generic-mechanism comparator EFR v2 explicitly compares FAR with a generic collision checker and forbids the confounded endpoints.
accumulated epistemic memory Registries, histories, hashes, and dependency impacts preserve learning, but no longitudinal evidence shows compounding outcome value.
contract-relative observation FAR Core defines comparison contracts and exact factorization; far-ir/2.0 enforces finite-explicit witnesses.
impact-aware dependency graph Dependency and reverse-impact machinery exists, but corpus-wide synthesis invalidation was not previously enforced.
governed pre-execution experiment design #518 and EFR encode preregistered inputs, endpoints, comparators, freezes, and nonclaims; this records design state only and supplies no outcome evidence.
hostile external input freeze Living intake already treats external bytes as untrusted data; the corpus adds a nonexecuting content-addressed receipt path rather than a second promotion route.
explicit negative knowledge Unknown, refutation, failure, exclusions, limitations, and open problems are first-class governed states.
content-addressed provenance Living promotion and governed ledgers bind exact paths, hashes, stages, and preimages.

source-to-frontier reconciliation Saturation v0.5 already specifies provenance-preserving synthesis and dependency-aware invalidation; this repository layer implements that existing extension/enforcement surface rather than proving a capability-class gap.
